FRACTURE LINE — Milestone 2 (skirmish: EU Alliance and TPLA).
Design, code, procedural 3D models, weathering, decals, shaders, effects, UI and text: original work made for Malachi Murphy with Grok Bot.
Textures: ambientCG (ambientcg.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — Ground097, Ground109, Grass004, Rock063, Asphalt033, Gravel035, Concrete034, CorrugatedSteel005, Rust004.
Soldier models and animations: Quaternius, "Toon Shooter Game Kit" (quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — recoloured per faction, decimated and baked to vertex animation.
Sound effects and music ("Dust Over Varno", "Steel Rain"): original, synthesized for this game.
Voices: AI-generated with the Kokoro-82M speech model (hexgrad, Apache-2.0) via kokoro-onnx (MIT); phonemes by eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0 build tool, only audio ships). Your own recordings in audio/voice replace them.
Inspired by the classic base-building RTS genre; no names, art, audio or text from any other game are used.
UI font: Godot's built-in default font.
Built with Godot Engine %s (MIT license, see below).
